mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aup_reviewer (user_id, reviewer_role, scope, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{reviewerRole}, #{scope}, #{enabled})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aup_reviewer WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND reviewer_role = #{reviewerRole} AND enabled = 1

SELECT r.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(p.name, r.user_id) AS name, p.department_name AS dept FROM aup_reviewer r LEFT JOIN aro_personnel p ON p.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.reviewer_role = 'expert' AND r.enabled = 1 ORDER BY r.id ASC

SELECT r.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(p.name, r.user_id) AS name, p.department_name AS dept FROM aup_reviewer r LEFT JOIN aro_personnel p ON p.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.reviewer_role = 'secretary' AND r.enabled = 1 ORDER BY r.id ASC
